correctness: Existing fixtures with disjoint restrict buffers; full-vector comparison at all three sizes and after each timed process. Relative tolerance 1e-9 and absolute tolerance 1e-12; reject nonfinite values.
sampling: Separate processes in randomized complete rounds, fifteen observations plus three warmups. Fixed inner repeats. Never pool inputs, sessions, Linux/Mac or historical campaigns.
holdout: Freeze session-1 choices before session 2. Adequacy threshold remains 2% relative to the smallest session-2 median including sequential.
statistics: Median, mean, sample SD, MAD, IQR; paired complete-round percentile bootstrap with 5000 resamples, seed 2026, conditional 95% intervals.
cost: Deterministic prefix only. No LLM calls or promotion in these two sessions; any later real inference requires a separate cost archive and explicit model/budget.
power: Record actual host and power conditions. No exclusive host, thermal or frequency control assumed.
scope: Prepared recipe for the historical four-core Linux host, not an executed experiment. Verify current affinity/cotas before collection; change and freeze a new protocol if the host differs. Whole-process perf collected separately after timing sessions.
